description:
• Brand introduction: In the world of luxury fashion and accessories, Italian craftsmanship has always been synonymous with quality, elegance, and enduring style. Bright Diamond, a distinguished Italian fine jewelry brand, exemplifies these timeless attributes. With a commitment to excellence and an unwavering dedication to creating exquisite pieces, Bright Diamond offers a collection of fine jewelry that stands as a testament to Italian artistry and craftsmanship.


• Product description: 

✨ Fine Materials, Exquisite Craftsmanship: At Bright Diamond, we meticulously craft our jewelry using the finest materials, including real 14-18k gold over sterling silver and resilient stainless steel.

💎 Stunning Beauty, Unmatched Durability: Our careful material selection ensures not just a striking appearance, but also remarkable toughness, guaranteeing that your Bright Diamond pieces remain as captivating as the day you acquired them.

🇮🇹 Italian Design Magic: With the fusion of gold and silver, we weave a unique harmony that captures the essence of Italian design – a perfect blend of timeless traditions and visionary innovation.

LIFETIME WARRANTY: Bright Diamond boldly declares its commitment to quality through its lifetime warranty. While many brands may offer warranties for a limited period, Bright Diamond assurance lasts FOREVER. This is a testament to the brand's unwavering faith in the craftsmanship and durability of its jewelry. With proper care, you can confidently wear your Bright Diamond piece every day, knowing that it's backed by a warranty that stands the test of time.

HYPOALLERGENIC BRILLIANCE, NICKEL-FREE ASSURANCE, EVERYDAY LUXURY:
Bright Diamond jewelry is designed to be more than just a special occasion adornment; it's meant to be a part of your everyday life. That's why our commitment to quality extends to ensuring that our jewelry is hypoallergenic and nickel-free. We recognize that skin sensitivities can be a concern for many, and we take great care to craft pieces that can be enjoyed by everyone. With Bright Diamond nickel-free jewelry, you can revel in the beauty of our exquisite designs without worrying about allergies or skin irritations. It's a testament to our dedication to providing jewelry that not only sparkles with elegance but also ensures your comfort and well-being. Choose Bright Diamond for jewelry that is not only visually stunning but also gentle on your skin, embodying the highest standards of both style and safety.

Affiliate Payment Terms Agreement

This Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into between Bright Dimaond, hereinafter referred to as the "Merchant," and Affiliates, hereinafter referred to as the "Affiliate," collectively referred to as the "Parties."

1. Commission: a. The Affiliate will receive a commission of 15% on the net sales generated through their unique affiliate link or promo code.

2. Payment Schedule: a. Commissions will be calculated and paid on a monthly basis. b. Payments will be made within two days following the end of each calendar month.

3. Commission Calculation: a. The commission is calculated on the net sales amount, excluding taxes, shipping, and returns. b. The Merchant will provide the Affiliate with access to a dashboard or report detailing the sales generated through the Affiliate's efforts.

4. Payment Method: a. Payments will be made via [chosen payment method, e.g., PayPal, Venmo, or direct bank transfer]. b. The Affiliate is responsible for providing accurate and up-to-date payment information.

5. Termination: a. Either party may terminate this agreement with written notice. b. Termination does not affect the right to receive commissions earned before the termination date.

6. Confidentiality: a. The Affiliate agrees to keep confidential any information about the Merchant's products, pricing, and customer data.

7. Compliance: a. The Affiliate agrees to comply with all applicable laws and regulations in their promotion of the Merchant's products.

8. Modification: a. This Agreement may be modified only in writing and signed by both Parties.


If you have any question, please do not hesitate to contact us at Admin@brightdiamond.us
